about: I'm Mudassir Javed, a cyber security graduate obsessed with the intersection of cryptography and secure systems.

I hold a BS in Cyber Security (KFUEIT, 2022–2026) with hands-on experience in applied cryptography, secure authentication and security auditing. I built and audited a post-quantum identity system, finished Top 10 in a national-level CTF, and mentored 100+ students.
I'm looking to start a career in information security within banking, helping protect customer data and systems.
